This candidate is a reasonable refinement based on prior evidence but has not yet been tested in a race. Depending on the next race results, if steering oscillations persist, consider further increasing kd or slightly lowering kp; if progress is low but stable, cautiously increase base speed; if line loss events occur, consider adjusting sensor weights or line loss strategy.
